Ive spent 5 months crawling around on my hands and knees picking up rusty nails, screws, random metal pieces from my 1/4 acre yard after moving in with my 2 year old, finding heaps every day. Finally found this product and did my entire yard in under an hour, found alot of very scary, sharp and some surprisingly large pieces, my grounds is very uneven, so I had a little trouble getting it over some tufts and had to empty it often, but seriously kicking myself I didnt buy this sooner, absoloutly my favourite tool for keeping my home safe! Now if only they made one for glass too 😅
